conditions: Release builds; each phase runs fresh processes in 10k,40k,40k,10k order. No concurrent builds/tests/native inputs during service timing. Sequential phases and warmed/uncontrolled filesystem caches, not statistical or physical-media acceptance.

nativeLimits: 10k capture overlaps indexing. Six scrolling inputs were attempted but the 60s automation timeout lost completion accounting; not a matched scroll run.

The 40k folder request and subsequent inspection exceeded 30s/60s accessibility timeouts. Its CPU capture diagnoses the requested workspace; complete folder/control/scroll acceptance was not verified.

The unresponsive development process was stopped after parking only the generated 40k corpus. Relaunch recovered to an unavailable-folder screen; original folder/focus/Preview/settings were restored through UI, test shortcuts removed, corpus restored and all 50k image hashes checked. No personal decisions/file operations were initiated.
Animation Hitches recording required lengthy finalization. An export attempted before completion failed; only the final successful export is reported. RSS sampling includes finalization.
CPU-only reports leave unavailable stall metrics null. No presented FPS, physical-trackpad feel, competitor parity or large-shoot acceptance claim.
harnessChanges: Baseline measures the same service workload without separate per-selection sub-timing; later phases add one elapsed-time read per selection.
Final reports explicitly document retained preflight inventory/hash allocations in service RSS; earlier reports have the same allocations.
The readiness-only phase retains redundant selection rebuilds; final phase also avoids rebuilding unchanged explicit membership on focus/order changes.
nativeSmallSelectionScope: Built-in three-photo samples: select all, group stars/flags, two-step Undo, Pick filter to no matches and Clear Filters; original folder/focus/Preview restored afterward. No personal decisions edited.
